title: Memory quality: knowledge, not records of a session (spec docs/superpowers/specs
input: Memory quality: knowledge, not records of a session (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-memory-quality-design.md)

criteria.text: AC-1 Host framing text and the sentences named in the noise filter never reach the judge; each drop is named
AC-2 A turn whose candidates the filter empties is skipped without a judge request
AC-3 A memory is stored only when its title sentence is knowledge (KNOWLEDGE_THRESHOLD); the Context line needs 5 prompt words
AC-4 Judge version 2: knowledge_<i> questions, reader in the state, contrastive criteria; golden floors hold for both judges with re-recorded answers
AC-5 Heuristic version 2 penalises report sentences and discounts a mostly-report answer
AC-8 The proof script measures the metrics of spec section 6 on a read-only copy and rehearses the cleanup with undo
AC-9 The noise filter has no protocol-tag or verdict pattern: such sentences reach the judge
AC-10 The import rejudge keeps the version 1 questions and stamps judge_version 1
AC-11 The proof script measures the metrics of the spec on a read-only copy, with TypeSafe verdicts only and injections bounded to the turn's end
AC-12 host-frame matches only the host's fixed lines at the start of a sentence: a sentence quoting one mid-sentence reaches the judge
AC-13 stripHost removes an unclosed block tag to the end of the text only when it opens a line outside code; a tag named in prose or backticks removes nothing
AC-14 The judge's user_prompt and assistant_final_message, and the Context line, hold no host block and no dropped sentence

decisions.question: What happens to the rejudge distilled cleanup (AC-6, AC-7) after spec review round 1?
decisions.answer: Separar num item novo: este item entrega AC-1 a AC-5 e a prova sem o ensaio da limpeza; a limpeza volta a ser desenhada noutro item

decisions.question: Does the import rejudge move to the version 2 questions?
decisions.answer: Fixar o rejudge em v1: as importadas não mudam nesta entrega

decisions.question: Do protocol-tag (0.88) and verdict (0.80) stay in the noise filter below the 97% entry rule?
decisions.answer: Tirá-los já: só ficam os padrões medidos

decisions.question: Who labels the proof's samples, and from which projects?
decisions.answer: Deveria ser configurável; o default depende do runtime que o cliente está a utilizar

decisions.question: Is there a ceiling on version 2 input tokens per turn?
decisions.answer: Teto: no máximo 2× os tokens de entrada da v1 medida

decisions.question: What gate protects keyless users (heuristic version 2) before the merge?
decisions.answer: Sem regressão face à heurística v1

decisions.question: After round 2 fixes: a third review round or accept?
Heuristic version 2 has no gain target: keep the report penalties or drop them?
decisions.answer: Manter as penalizações, com meta: a heurística v2 tem de guardar menos registos do que a v1 nas amostras B e S

decisions.question: TypeSafe price and duration in the spec?
decisions.answer: Só o medido: custo e duração medidos pela prova e registados no ADR

decisions.question: Round 3 at 23 Majors after stages 5-7: stop or finish the round?
decisions.answer: Acabar a 3.ª ronda e decidir depois

decisions.question: Round 3 stopped on no progress (31 vs 29 Blockers and Majors): accept, go on, or redraft?
decisions.answer: Corrigir tudo isto e aceitar, sem 4.ª ronda

decisions.question: Sample B missed two targets (records 24% vs ≤15%; version 2 loses 11 turns version 1 kept): accept with the losses named, recalibrate on a fresh sample, or not merge?
decisions.answer: 1 — aceitar as perdas e os records que ficam, com nome; ADR accepted com as duas metas falhadas registadas

decisions.question: AC-4 has no test-first record after the forced merge of T-6: reproduce the red against the pre-T-6 questions now, or leave the item not proven?
decisions.answer: Reproduzir o red: as perguntas de antes da T-6 (ef17a98) postas temporariamente, red gravado agora, depois o código atual e o green; o relatório diz que o red foi reproduzido depois do código

removedCriteria.text: AC-6 Migration 8 adds memory_reviews; NewMemory accepts sourceOrdinal
AC-7 rejudge distilled supersedes, archives or keeps each version-1 distilled memory from its source turn, resumes, dry-runs without writing, and --undo restores the counts
